design.purpose: A sturdy open storage basket for yarn, toys or household items, made by one beginner using both photographed yarns.

steps.c: Place green yarn, blue yarn and hook ready.
Green: magic ring, Rnd 1: 6 sc; Rnd 2: inc in each stitch.
Rnd 3: (sc, inc) six times; Rnd 4: (2 sc, inc) six times.
Rnd 5: (3 sc, inc) six times; check stitch count.
Rnd 6: sc in back loop only of every stitch.
Rnds 7–8: sc in every stitch, join with sl st.
Change to blue on final loop; Rnd 9: sc around.
Rnd 10: sc in every stitch, join with sl st.
Rnd 11: sc around, sl st to join, fasten off.
Cut the tail, leaving enough yarn to weave in.
Weave all tails through nearby stitches with the hook.
